for name,(path,passed,skipped) in inputs.items():
 raw=Path(path).read_bytes(); suites=ET.fromstring(raw).findall('testsuite'); assert len(suites)==1
 suite=suites[0]; cases=suite.findall('testcase'); ids=[(c.attrib['classname'],c.attrib['name']) for c in cases]
 assert len(cases)==passed+skipped and len(set(ids))==len(ids)
 assert int(suite.attrib['tests'])==len(cases) and int(suite.attrib['failures'])==int(suite.attrib['errors'])==0
 assert int(suite.attrib['skipped'])==skipped
 assert all(c.find('failure') is None and c.find('error') is None for c in cases)
 assert all(len(c.findall('skipped'))<=1 for c in cases)
 assert sum(c.find('skipped') is not None for c in cases)==skipped
 assert sum(c.find('skipped') is None for c in cases)==passed
 assert Path(path).read_bytes()==raw
 result['suites'][name]={'path':path,'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'passed':passed,'skipped':skipped,'failures':0,'errors':0,'unique_cases':len(cases),'junit_seconds':suite.attrib['time']}
 repo=root if name=='core' else root.parent/'orze-pro'
 for module,functions in selected.get(name,{}).items():
  rel='tests/'+module+'.py'; source=(repo/rel).read_bytes()
  old=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),'show',base[name]+':'+rel]); assert old==source
  checks={}
  for function in functions:
   matches=[c for c in cases if c.attrib['classname'].split('.')[-1]==module and c.attrib['name'].split('[',1)[0]==function]
   assert matches and all(c.find('skipped') is None for c in matches)
   checks[function]=[c.attrib['name'] for c in matches]
  result['representatives'][name+'/'+rel]={'sha256':hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),'baseline_byte_exact':True,'passed_cases':checks}
result['representative_case_count']=sum(len(nodes) for file in result['representatives'].values() for nodes in file['passed_cases'].values())
print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True))
